responsibility: Drives the Integrated Register Allocator and its handoff to reload or LRA, and registers the corresponding RTL passes. This file orchestrates overall IRA execution, option-controlled selection between legacy reload and LRA, allocator setup/teardown, post-allocation cleanup, dataflow rescanning, DCE, frame/global-register diagnostics, stack-check warnings, and utility handling such as nullifying impossible asm goto patterns. It is the control-plane entry point for GCC’s register allocation stage rather than an IRA analysis or transformation component itself.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem source file is the executable IRA driver and pass implementation: it runs IRA, decides the handoff to legacy reload versus LRA, and registers the IRA/reload RTL passes. The companion header gcc/ira.h instead exposes the public IRA state, target tables, and helper declarations used by other backend code.
